Do not use its CPU/maxima or whole-window resource values for release acceptance. The old JSON omitted process states, so it cannot independently delimit a trustworthy live-only interval.

behavior: Read process state from /proc/PID/stat and status.
Stop with target_exited on Z/X/x and discard any sample spanning exit.
Do not append dead-state CPU/RSS zeros; initial zombie resources remain null with zero samples.
Incomplete captures set requested_duration_completed=false and usable_for_requested_duration=false and return 4; only a complete duration with at least two live samples returns 0.
limitations: Real Linux zombie state Z exercised; transient X/x covered by the same membership check, not forced in a real process.
Selfcheck measurements are script validation, not SN100 app resource evidence.
